ceu: ✦ The square between the Sun and Pluto

s.k: Look at what you have, not at what you lack.
t: With the Moon in your house of values, you crave comfort and concrete things. Choose with your head before you spend.
The square between the Sun and Pluto creates some tension between intimacy and friendships. Breathe before reacting, because haste is the worst adviser today.
With Mercury retrograde in your intimacy sector, an old matter may come back, and it is worth closing it properly.
s.d: Tidy your wallet and your papers: order attracts clarity.

s.k: A day to put yourself first.
t: Today the Moon visits your sign and puts your energy in the spotlight. People notice you more, so show your best side.
The square between the Sun and Pluto creates some tension between relationships and your career. If something goes wrong, it is just an adjustment and not the end.
With Venus retrograde in your daily routine sector, review what you value before making choices in love or money.
s.d: Say no to a request that takes you away from your priorities.

s.k: A day to recharge on the inside.
t: A day for prayer, meditation or a simple walk on your own. The peace you find today stays with you.
The square between the Sun and Pluto creates some tension between routine and your horizons. Tension is a sign of growth, not of failure.
With Mercury retrograde in your daily routine sector, it is a time to review and correct, not to sign in a hurry.
s.d: Settle an old matter before starting something new.

s.k: Share a dream with someone who believes in it.
t: The Moon passes through your area of friends and projects. Good company gives you energy today.
The square between the Sun and Pluto creates some tension between romance and intimacy. Say what you feel calmly and without blaming.
With Venus retrograde in your home and family sector, it is better to adjust what already exists than to start something new.
s.d: Join a group or a conversation about a subject you enjoy.

s.k: Your goals ask for a firm step.
t: Today work and reputation carry emotional weight. Praise or criticism touches you more than usual.
The square between the Sun and Pluto creates some tension between family and relationships. Hear both sides before you decide.
With Mercury retrograde in your home and family sector, double-check dates, messages and contracts before moving forward.
s.d: Show your work: people who do not show up are not remembered.

s.k: A day to learn and broaden your horizons.
t: With the Moon in your house of wisdom, the day asks for meaning: ask yourself where you want to go, not just how.
The square between the Sun and Pluto creates some tension between conversations and routine. Protect your peace and choose the battles worth fighting.
With Venus retrograde in your money sector, people and feelings from the past may become important again.
s.d: Listen to a podcast or a talk on a new subject.

s.k: Trust is the word of the day.
t: The Moon touches intimacy and strong bonds. Open up to those who deserve it, and only to those who deserve it.
The square between the Sun and Pluto creates some tension between money and romance. A short pause avoids a long argument.
With Mercury retrograde in your money sector, an old matter may come back, and it is worth closing it properly.
s.d: Write on a piece of paper what you want to be free of and tear it up.

s.k: Today the other person is your mirror.
t: A good day for agreements and serious conversations with those who walk beside you. Be clear and fair.
The square between the Sun and Pluto creates some tension between your image and family. Today's challenge is teaching you patience.
With Venus retrograde in your inner life sector, review what you value before making choices in love or money.
s.d: Clear up a misunderstanding with a calm conversation.

s.k: Organise the day and the day will organise you.
t: The Moon passes through your area of routine and health. Organising the day is the best way to make the most of it.
The square between the Sun and Pluto creates some tension between your inner life and conversations. Do not take to heart what has nothing to do with you.
With Mercury retrograde in your inner life sector, it is a time to review and correct, not to sign in a hurry.
s.d: Tidy your desk before you start.

s.k: Your heart wants a celebration and a little light.
t: Today your heart is lighter and more playful. It is a good day for romance and for small pleasures.
The square between the Sun and Pluto creates some tension between friendships and money. Put off big decisions until the dust settles.
With Venus retrograde in your career sector, it is better to adjust what already exists than to start something new.
s.d: Write something lovely about someone you care for.

s.k: The heart of the day is at home.
t: With the Moon in your house of roots, old memories may return. Welcome them without getting stuck in them.
The square between the Sun and Pluto creates some tension between your career and your image. Do one thing at a time and the day will calm down.
With Mercury retrograde in your career sector, double-check dates, messages and contracts before moving forward.
s.d: Phone an older relative and listen to them without hurry.

s.k: One conversation can change the course of the day.
t: The Moon livens up short trips and contact with siblings, neighbours and colleagues. A day on the move.
The square between the Sun and Pluto creates some tension between your horizons and your inner life. You do not have to choose right now: look for the middle ground.
With Venus retrograde in your intimacy sector, people and feelings from the past may become important again.
s.d: Learn a new word or a new thing today, out of curiosity.
